title: How cymbals were mounted on the bass drum over time
summary: Robertson describes the old practice of carrying a cymbal in the hand, later replaced by a mounted cymbal with a beater, because the old way made too much noise.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used
